note: No value below is from a specific vendor datasheet: this design names no part numbers. Every figure is a stated design rule or an explicit assumption, and says which. RF, RFB2, CF, CFB, CISS and the sources deliberately have no entry: a check on them is NOT_CHECKED / no_material_data.

ambient_c.source: assumed: air temperature inside a closed motor-drive enclosure; not measured

RSH.description: 2 mOhm current-sense shunt, 2512 metal-element, 2 W class

p_max_w.source: design_rule: the README sizes RSH for a 2 W 2512 shunt (0.8 W at 20 A must fit with margin)

rth_c_per_w.source: design_rule: derived from a typical 2512 metal-element derating curve (full rated power at 70 degC, zero at 170 degC): (170 - 70) K / 2 W = 50 K/W on its reference board; not one part's datasheet

cth_j_per_k.source: assumed: part body plus the copper directly under its pads, giving tau = 5 s; order of magnitude only

t_max_c.source: design_rule: keep any part below 125 degC so the FR-4 under it stays below its glass transition

RG.description: 10 Ohm gate resistor, 0805 thick film, 0.125 W class

p_max_w.source: design_rule: 0805 thick-film resistors are commonly rated 0.125 W at 70 degC

rth_chain.name: body-to-pads
rth_chain.source: assumed: about half of the derating-curve figure below is the part itself

rth_chain.name: pads-to-ambient
rth_chain.source: assumed: the rest is the board and air; together they match (155 - 70) K / 0.125 W = 680 K/W from a typical 0805 derating curve (design rule)

t_max_c.source: design_rule: keep any part below 125 degC so the FR-4 under it stays below its glass transition
